```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
```

## Load Data 

```{r updated data}
coc_data <- read_csv("coc_data.csv")
coc_data_1_ <- read_csv("coc_data (1).csv")
```

## mutate data 

```{r}
coc_data <- coc_data |>
  mutate(funding_per_person = funding_tot / `Overall Homeless`,
         equity_score = funding_per_person / poverty_rate)|>
  filter(!is.na(equity_score), is.finite(equity_score))

coc_data_1 <- coc_data_1 |>
  mutate(funding_per_person = funding_tot / `Overall Homeless`)

coc_data_1 <- coc_data_1 |> 
  mutate(homeless_rate = `Overall Homeless`/total_population)

```


## Model for ages, population, and poverty

```{r model}
model_data <- coc_long |>
  filter(funding_per_person > 0, homeless_count > 0) |>
  mutate(
    log_funding = log(funding_per_person),
    log_homeless = log(homeless_count)
  )
model <- lm(log_funding ~ log_homeless + poverty_rate + total_population + age_group, data = model_data)

summary(model)
```

```{r longer weighted data}
coc_long_1 <- coc_data_1_ |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Overall Homeless - Under 18`, `Overall Homeless - Age 18 to 24`, `Overall Homeless - Age 25 to 34`, `Overall Homeless - Age 35 to 44`, `Overall Homeless - Age 45 to 54`, `Overall Homeless - Age 55 to 64`, `Overall Homeless - Over 64`),
    names_to = "age_group",
    values_to = "homeless_count")|>  
  mutate(
    age_group = str_replace(age_group, "Overall Homeless - ", ""),
    funding_per_person = funding_tot / homeless_count,
    homeless_rate = homeless_count/`Overall Homeless`) |>
  filter(homeless_count > 0)
```


```{r facets with weighted data}
myfacet <- coc_long_1 |>
  ggplot(aes(x = funding_per_person, y = homeless_rate)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = poverty_rate, text = paste0(
        "Population: ", total_population, "<br>",
        "Poverty Rate: ", poverty_rate, "%"
      )), alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "darkred", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_log10() + 
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~ age_group, scales = "free") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 10)) + 
  labs(
    title = "Log-Transformed Funding per Person vs. Homeless Count by Age Group",
    x = "Log of Funding per Homeless Person (USD)",
    y = "Log of Homeless Count",
    size = "Total Population",
    color = "Poverty Rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
interactive_myfacet <- ggplotly(myfacet, tooltip = "text")
interactive_myfacet
```

```{r model for weighted data}
model_data1 <- coc_long_1 |>
  filter(funding_per_person > 0, homeless_count > 0) |>

model1 <- lm(log_funding ~ log_homeless + poverty_rate + total_population + age_group, data = model_data1)
```

```{r}
coc_data_1 <- coc_data_1 |>
  mutate(funding_per_homeless = funding_tot/`Overall Homeless`)

myplot <- coc_data_1 |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_jitter(aes(x = funding_per_homeless, y = homeless_rate, color = poverty_rate)) +   
  text = paste0(
    "CoC: ",coc_name , "<br>",
    "Poverty Rate: ", scales::percent(poverty_rate, accuracy = 0.1)) +
   scale_x_log10( 
     breaks = c(100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000), 
     labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
   scale_y_log10(
  breaks = c(0.1, 0.01, 0.001, 0.0001),
  labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  scale_color_continuous(type = "viridis", labels =   scales::percent_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Federal funding per capita vs. Homelessness for each CoC",
    x = "Funding per homeless individual",
    y = "Rate of homelessness",
    color = "Poverty rate"
  )

ggplotly(myplot, tooltip = "text")
```

### Pie chart 

```{r}
race_totals <- coc_data_1 |>
  summarise(
    American_Indian_Alaska_Native = sum(amer_indian_ak_native, na.rm = TRUE),
    Asian = sum(asian, na.rm = TRUE),
    Black = sum(black, na.rm = TRUE),
    Native_Hawaiian_Other_PI = sum(native_hi_other_pi, na.rm = TRUE),
    Other_Race = sum(other_race, na.rm = TRUE),
    White = sum(white, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Race", values_to = "Total")

race_totals <- race_totals |>
  mutate(Percentage = Total / sum(Total) * 100)

  
colors <- c(
  "American_Indian_Alaska_Native" = "#1f77b4",
  "Asian" = "#ff7f0e",
  "Black" = "#2ca02c",
  "Native_Hawaiian_Other_PI" = "#d62728",
  "Other_Race" = "#9467bd",  # <- custom color for Other Race
  "White" = "#8c564b"
)
  
plot_ly(
  race_totals,
  labels = ~Race,
  values = ~Total,
  type = 'pie',
  textinfo = 'none',
  hoverinfo = 'label+percent',
  marker = list(colors = colors[race_totals$Race])
) |>
  layout(title = "Interactive Breakdown of Homeless Population by Race")
```

### density plots

```{r load data}
coc_data_updated <- read.csv("coc_data_new.csv")
county_data <- read.csv("county_data_take2.csv")
```

```{r renaming variables}
library(dplyr)
library(janitor)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
county_data_take2 <- county_data_take2 |> janitor::clean_names()
```

```{r}
ccc <- county_data_take2 |>
  group_by(coc_num) |>
  summarise(
    total_population = sum(total_pop, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_homeless = mean(overall_homeless, na.rm = TRUE),
    homeless_rate = mean(overall_homeless, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(total_pop, na.rm = TRUE),

    hmls_AIAN = mean(overall_homeless_american_indian_alaska_native_or_indigenous, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(overall_homeless, na.rm = TRUE),
    hmls_asian = mean(overall_homeless_asian_or_asian_american, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(overall_homeless, na.rm = TRUE),
    hmls_black = mean(overall_homeless_black_african_american_or_african, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(overall_homeless, na.rm = TRUE),
    hmls_multi = mean(overall_homeless_multi_racial, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(overall_homeless, na.rm = TRUE),
    hmls_NHPI = mean(overall_homeless_native_hawaiian_or_other_pacific_islander, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(overall_homeless, na.rm = TRUE),
    hmls_white = mean(overall_homeless_white + overall_homeless_middle_eastern_or_north_african, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(overall_homeless, na.rm = TRUE),

    pop_AIAN = sum(amer_indian_ak_native, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(popest - other_race, na.rm = TRUE),
    pop_asian = sum(asian, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(popest - other_race, na.rm = TRUE),
    pop_black = sum(black, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(popest - other_race, na.rm = TRUE),
    pop_multi = sum(multi_racial, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(popest - other_race, na.rm = TRUE),
    pop_NHPI = sum(native_hi_other_pi, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(popest - other_race, na.rm = TRUE),
    pop_white = sum(white, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(popest - other_race, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Remove row 371 (optional, may need explanation)
ccc <- ccc[-c(371), ]

# Calculate racial gaps
ccc <- ccc |>
  mutate(
    gap_AIAN = hmls_AIAN - pop_AIAN,
    gap_asian = hmls_asian - pop_asian,
    gap_black = hmls_black - pop_black,
    gap_multi = hmls_multi - pop_multi,
    gap_NHPI = hmls_NHPI - pop_NHPI,
    gap_white = hmls_white - pop_white
  )

# Standard deviation of each gap
ddd <- ccc |>
  summarise(
    sd_AIAN = sqrt(sum(gap_AIAN^2) / n()),
    sd_asian = sqrt(sum(gap_asian^2) / n()),
    sd_black = sqrt(sum(gap_black^2) / n()),
    sd_multi = sqrt(sum(gap_multi^2) / n()),
    sd_NHPI = sqrt(sum(gap_NHPI^2) / n()),
    sd_white = sqrt(sum(gap_white^2) / n())
  )

# Normalize the gaps by standard deviation
ccc <- ccc |>
  mutate(
    sd_gap_AIAN = gap_AIAN / ddd$sd_AIAN,
    sd_gap_asian = gap_asian / ddd$sd_asian,
    sd_gap_black = gap_black / ddd$sd_black,
    sd_gap_multi = gap_multi / ddd$sd_multi,
    sd_gap_NHPI = gap_NHPI / ddd$sd_NHPI,
    sd_gap_white = gap_white / ddd$sd_white
  )

# Median SD gap
xxx <- ccc |>
  summarise(
    aIAN = median(sd_gap_AIAN),
    asian = median(sd_gap_asian),
    black = median(sd_gap_black),
    multi = median(sd_gap_multi),
    nHPI = median(sd_gap_NHPI),
    white = median(sd_gap_white)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "race", values_to = "median_sd")

# Mean SD gap
yyy <- ccc |>
  summarise(
    aIAN = mean(sd_gap_AIAN),
    asian = mean(sd_gap_asian),
    black = mean(sd_gap_black),
    multi = mean(sd_gap_multi),
    nHPI = mean(sd_gap_NHPI),
    white = mean(sd_gap_white)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "race", values_to = "mean_sd")

# All CoCs: long format
zzz <- ccc |>
  select(coc_num, starts_with("sd_gap_")) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -coc_num, names_to = "race", values_to = "sd_gap")

# Plot: Median gap (in SD units)
ggplot(xxx, aes(x = race, y = -median_sd, fill = race)) + 
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Median Racial Gap in Homelessness vs. Population (%) by SD")

# Plot: Mean gap
ggplot(yyy, aes(x = race, y = -mean_sd, fill = race)) + 
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Mean Racial Gap in Homelessness vs. Population (%) by SD")

# Density plot of SD gaps
ggplot(zzz, aes(x = sd_gap, color = race)) +
  geom_density() +
  scale_x_log10(labels = comma_format()) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Racial Gaps (Standard Deviations)", x = "Gap (SDs)")

# Example: Compare white share of homeless vs. population
ggplot(ccc) +
  geom_density(aes(x = hmls_white), fill = "gray60", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_density(aes(x = pop_white), color = "gray20") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(
    title = "White (incl. MENA): Homeless vs Population Share",
    x = "Share",
    y = "Density"
  )
```

```{r more density plots}
# White (including MENA)
ggplot(ccc) +
  geom_density(aes(x = hmls_white), fill = "gray60", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_density(aes(x = pop_white), color = "gray20") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  labs(title = "White: Homeless vs Population Share",
       x = "Share", y = "Density")

```


### adding legend to side by side density plots 


```{r black}
ggplot(ccc) +
  geom_density(aes(x = hmls_black, fill = "Homeless Share"), alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_density(aes(x = pop_black, fill = "Population Share"), alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Group",
    values = c("Homeless Share" = "blue", "Population Share" = "black")
  ) +
  labs(title = "Black", x = "Share", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()
```
